about: Machine-readable configuration, environment, checks, and file index for the fixed-workload Leduc Deep CFR implementation benchmark. This is not a convergence experiment.

file_descriptions.plot: Total time, phase timing, traversal throughput, and peak memory.
file_descriptions.runs: Every isolated timing, phase breakdown, memory peak, and exact metric.
file_descriptions.summary: Median performance, variation, memory, and exact final quality.

metric_definitions.collection_traversals_per_second: Fixed-workload traversals divided only by measured traversal collection time.
metric_definitions.end_to_end_traversals_per_second: Fixed-workload traversals divided by complete solver training time.
metric_definitions.median_absolute_deviation: Median distance from the median, used as a robust variation measure.
metric_definitions.peak_memory: Highest sampled memory total across the training process and its children.
metric_definitions.traversal: One sampled root traversal for one traversing player.
